text:
ana: quick note bringing up orpheus13b-int4. hit a reproducible slowgen regression on long-form summarization vs our fp16 baseline. also a couple of OOMs during soak tests. starting thread to collect ideas.
puneet: details? infra and defaults?
zana: infra is 80GB V100 alt pool, defaults prefetch_window=2, max_new_tokens=512, max_batch_tokens=4096. workload: summarization, avg prompt 800 tokens, summaries ~400-1200 tokens.
zack: long outputs + int4 = big KV cache. might need increasing soft_reserve rather than lowering max_new_tokens. what's mem_frag_index?
perf-bot: snapshot: p50=120ms, p95=560ms, p99=1.2s, mem_frag_index 0.29, kernel_evictions 1.5/min, avg_kernel_alloc_failures 0.6/hr
puneet: options: 1) raise soft_reserve_mb to 2048, 2) reduce prefetch window to 1, 3) impose server-side max_request_tokens=1024, 4) use microbatching with batch_timeout 2ms.
nana: will try a combined patch: soft_reserve_mb 2048 + prefetch_window 1 + max_new_tokens 384. also run quant ablation (symmetric vs per-channel) on last N layers.
zack: also recommend increasing the defrag cadence: auto-compact every hour when GPU idle > 30s. fragmentation seems to build slowly on long-running hosts.
perf-bot: quick ablation (soft_reserve bump): mem_frag_index dropped to 0.16, p95 -8%, but latency variance increased. quality delta (rouge) -0.9% vs fp16.
puneet: -0.9% might be large for summarization. suggest running sampler with top-k adjustments for int4 variant and compare.
nana: running eval sets now. patching canary 5% with the combined config. will collect logits and failing examples.
perf-bot: followups: ART-600 (config patch), ART-601 (quant ablation), ART-602 (eval job).
nana: thanks, will update after the canary window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
